standard_prerequisites.use: The first reduces the vanishing of the difference of two composites to the case of an integral base, and the second replaces the object by a bounded complex of finite locally free modules of constant rank on a proper birational model.

standard_prerequisites.name: Centricity and commutation for Chern classes of locally free modules, and the construction of Chern classes as polynomials in them
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-cap-commutative-chern (proof line 9421, claimed as S14-algebra-cap-commutative-chern)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the commutation for each of the locally free terms, whence for the polynomial expression defining the Chern class of the complex.

core_obligations: Reduce part (1) to part (2), and reduce the commutation statement to the vanishing of the difference of the two composites using the vanishing criterion and the integral base reduction (proof lines 9406-9410).
Replace the object by a complex: by the computation statement one may assume the object is represented by a bounded complex of finite locally free modules of constant rank (proof lines 9410-9414).

Conclude: the required equality of capped classes is immediate from the commutation for locally free modules together with the construction of the Chern class of the complex as a polynomial in the Chern classes of its terms (proof lines 9415-9423).
proof_roadmap: Reductions to an integral base and a representing complex (proof lines 9406-9414).
Commutation for the terms of the complex (proof lines 9415-9421).
Conclusion via the polynomial construction (proof lines 9421-9423).
difficulty_reason: The lemma extends centrality and commutation with bivariant classes from locally free modules to perfect objects whose Chern classes are defined (statement lines 9393-9404, tag 0F9F-adjacent). The proof reduces by the vanishing criterion to an integral base, uses the computation statement to represent the object by a bounded complex of finite locally free modules of constant rank, and then applies the commutation for locally free modules together with the polynomial construction of the Chern class of the complex. The reduction chain is the substance, so the claim is H2.
